title: Sell Ad Management to Businesses Already Running Ads
summary: Target companies that already spend on ads, show them better angles from their own customers and pitch a managed retainer.

money_potential.label: High
money_potential.basis: Assumes a monthly management fee per client, so each signed account repeats.
money_potential.note: Money tiers are our estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative earning potential, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: Active advertisers already have a budget, so the pitch is about results, not convincing.
Sample angles make the pitch concrete.
who_its_for: Freelance media buyers and small performance agencies.

stack.name: Ad-Active Lead Finder
stack.role: Finds companies running ads in your niche.
stack.creator: aferrari

stack.name: Site Audit
stack.role: Scores each landing page and lists fixes.
stack.creator: scheemunai

stack.name: Customer-Voice Ad Writer
stack.role: Writes sample ad copy from real customer words.
stack.creator: buildingadlicio

stack.name: Prospect Meeting Booker
stack.role: Drafts a meeting request to the decision-maker.
stack.creator: benln

steps: Choose a niche where you have results.
Run the lead finder and audit the top landing pages.
Build a one-page pitch with three sample angles.
Send it yourself and book calls.
guardrails: Every message and document stays a draft until you approve it.
Check local rules on cold outreach, calls and texts before contacting anyone.
